name: community-lab-ide
description: Community Lab IDE: an independent desktop IDE for actuarial agent-based simulation. A province where every person is an agent, on published South African bases, with double-entry books, a burial society, paired experiments on a local worker pool and a workbench of scenario, experiment and script files. Runs offline; a local model scripts the conversations.

scripts.build: bun run bundle:server && bun run build:main
scripts.dist:linux: bun run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.dist:win: TARGET_OS=win bun run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: TARGET_OS=mac bun run build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
